Table 2 Growth conditions used for the deposition of LaAlO 3 by liquid injection ALD using [LaAl(OPr i)6(PriOH)]2
Substrate temperature 160–300 uC
Evaporator temperature 175 uC
Pressure 5 mbar
Injection rate 2.5 ml per pulse
(4 pulses per cycle)
Solvent Toluene
Concentration 0.05 M
Argon flow 200 cm 3 min-1
Pulse sequence (precursor/purge/water/purge) 2/2/0.5/3.5
Number of cycles 400
